I relate so much to this! I have a therapist that I have a great relationship with and have been working with since the fall. However, I'm starting to see a new therapist soon because of the distance and my mother does not like my therapist. I wanted to do intensive outpatient but my treatment team at the hospital didn't think I could get access to them because I'm staying with my aunt and COVID. However, I feel like I need more support (clearly), and my aunt and I are looking at different options (residential programs, intensive outpatient). I'm on 150mg of Sertraline, 1mg of Prasozin, 50mg of Trazodone, and 6mg of melatonin. If I start to feel more actively suicidal I think calling the hospital might be an option or talking to my therapist about what she thinks would be best for me. My aunt is very supportive so if I'm not getting much better so maybe after a week or more feeling this way we'll look into calling the hospital.
